task_completion.description: Create a new tiddler titled 'Project Dashboard'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler with the title 'Project Dashboard' is visible in the TiddlyWiki story river or sidebar.

task_completion.description: Assign the tag 'Dashboard' to the new tiddler.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tag 'Dashboard' is visible in the tag area of the 'Project Dashboard' tiddler.
The rendered 'Project Dashboard' tiddler shows three distinct headings (e.g., using ! or <h1>) for Todo, InProgress, and Done.

task_completion.description: Use the <$count> widget to show the total number of items in each category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Numerical values representing the count of tasks are visible under each heading in the rendered tiddler.

task_completion.description: Use the <$list> widget to dynamically display tiddlers as clickable links.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Lists of blue clickable links (tiddler titles) are visible under each heading. The content should not be static text but interactive links.

task_completion.description: Ensure the dashboard uses dynamic filters (e.g., [tag[Todo]]) rather than hardcoded titles.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the tiddler's 'edit' mode, the wikitext shows filter strings like '[tag[Todo]]' or '[tag[InProgress]]' inside the widgets instead of a manual list of task names.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface to create and edit the tiddler.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the 'plus' button, the edit fields, and the 'save' checkmark within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal commands to inject tiddler files directly into the wiki folder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's actions are primarily within the browser window, not a command-line interface.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or constructed the wikitext rather than just viewing an existing dashboard.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Project Dashboard' tiddler is seen in 'edit' mode with the agent entering the <$list> and <$count> syntax.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target tiddler must be titled exactly 'Project Dashboard' and must have the tag 'Dashboard'. It must use TiddlyWiki widgets (<$list> and <$count>) to display tasks tagged 'Todo', 'InProgress', and 'Done'. Hardcoded lists of titles are not acceptable; dynamic filters must be used.
